# Differential accessibility

## Peak-level accessibility at costimulatory and MHC-II loci

```{r}
# ---- Load peak x gene x contrast table from the DA report ----
target_res <- read_csv(params$target_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)
str(target_res)

# ---- Selected genes; each peak kept only under its nearest TSS (H2 windows overlap) ----
genes_pub <- tribble(
  ~gene_name, ~class,
  "Cd40",   "Co-st.",
  "Cd80",   "Co-st.",
  "Ciita",   "MHC-II",
  "H2-Aa",  "MHC-II",
  "H2-Ab1", "MHC-II",
  "H2-Ea", "MHC-II",
  "H2-Eb1", "MHC-II")

tr_pub <- target_res |>
  filter(gene_name %in% genes_pub$gene_name) |>
  select(-class) |>
  left_join(genes_pub, by = "gene_name") |>
  group_by(peak_id, contrast) |>
  slice_min(abs(dist_tss_kb), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup()

tr_pub |> distinct(peak_id, gene_name) |> dplyr::count(gene_name)
```

```{r, fig.width = 6.7, fig.height = 4.4}
# ---- Plot: one point per peak, KO vs NTC log2FC per condition ----
prom_lab    <- "Promoter (\u00b11 kb)"
sig_lab     <- paste("FDR <", params$fdr)
cond_labels <- c(VEH = "Vehicle", AZA = "AZA", AZA_IFNg = "AZA + IFN-\u03b3")

plot_df <- tr_pub |>
  mutate(condition = factor(cond_labels[str_remove(contrast, "^.*_vs_NTC_")], levels = cond_labels),
         class     = factor(class, levels = unique(genes_pub$class)),
         gene_name = factor(gene_name, levels = rev(genes_pub$gene_name)),
         sig       = factor(if_else(FDR < params$fdr, sig_lab, "n.s."), levels = c(sig_lab, "n.s.")),
         region    = factor(if_else(promoter, prom_lab, "Distal"), levels = c(prom_lab, "Distal"))) |>
  arrange(desc(region))

lim <- max(1, ceiling(max(abs(plot_df$logFC)) * 2) / 2)

p_targets <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(logFC, gene_name)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(aes(shape = region, size = region, fill = sig),
             colour = "grey20", stroke = 0.4,
             position = position_jitter(width = 0, height = 0.18, seed = 1)) +
  facet_grid(class ~ condition, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = setNames(c(23, 21), c(prom_lab, "Distal"))) +
  scale_size_manual(values = setNames(c(5, 3), c(prom_lab, "Distal"))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = setNames(c("#B2182B", "grey85"), c(sig_lab, "n.s."))) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-lim, lim), breaks = c(-1, 0, 1)) +
  guides(
  fill  = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, size = 4)),
  shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "grey85"))
) +
  labs(x = expression(log[2]~"fold change (KO / NTC)"), y = NULL,
       shape = NULL, size = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 20) +
  theme(axis.text.y        = element_text(face = "italic", colour = "black" ),
          strip.background   = element_blank(),
          strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold"),
          panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey92"),
          legend.position    = "bottom")

p_targets
```

# Motif enrichment

## Inputs

```{r}
# ---- Shared style ----
pal_geno  <- c(NTC = "grey45", KO = "#B2182B")
pal_motif <- c(STAT1 = "#E69F00", Irf1 = "#0072B2", `STAT1::STAT2` = "#009E73")

theme_pub <- theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.line        = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
        axis.ticks       = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
        strip.background = element_blank(),

```

```{r}
stopifnot(file.exists(c(params$edger_rds, params$class_rds, params$genome_fa, params$gtf)))

edger_obj <- readRDS(params$edger_rds)
cls_se    <- readRDS(params$class_rds)
fa        <- FaFile(params$genome_fa)
gtf       <- import(params$gtf, format = "gtf", feature.type = c("gene", "transcript", "exon"))

# ---- BAMs of the samples used in the DA ----
bam_files <- list.files(params$bam_dir, pattern = "\\.mLb\\.clN\\.sorted\\.bam$", full.names = TRUE)
names(bam_files) <- str_remove(basename(bam_files), "\\.mLb\\.clN\\.sorted\\.bam$")
bam_files <- bam_files[colnames(edger_obj$y)]
stopifnot(!anyNA(bam_files))

# ---- Consensus peaks and track PWMs (from the monaLisa results) ----
all_peaks <- GRanges(edger_obj$res[[1]]$peak_id)
all_peaks$peak_id <- edger_obj$res[[1]]$peak_id

pwm_all   <- rowData(cls_se[[1]])$motif.pwm
track_pwm <- pwm_all[map_chr(as.list(pwm_all), name) %in% params$track_motifs]
```

```{r}
# ---- TMM-scaled coverage, averaged per group ----
get_tmm_coverage <- function(region, y, bam_files, groups, bin_width) {
  chr  <- as.character(seqnames(region))
  bins <- keepSeqlevels(tile(region, width = bin_width)[[1]], chr, pruning.mode = "coarse")
  smp  <- tibble(sample  = colnames(y),
                 group   = as.character(y$samples$group),
                 eff_lib = y$samples$lib.size * y$samples$norm.factors) |>
    filter(group %in% groups)

  pmap(smp, \(sample, group, eff_lib) {
    frag <- readGAlignmentPairs(bam_files[[sample]], param = ScanBamParam(which = region)) |>
      granges(on.discordant.seqnames = "drop")
    b <- binnedAverage(bins, coverage(frag)[chr], "cov")
    tibble(group = group, start = start(b), end = end(b), score = b$cov * 1e6 / eff_lib)
  }) |>
    bind_rows() |>
    summarise(score = mean(score), .by = c(group, start, end)) |>
          mutate(genotype  = factor(str_extract(group, "^[^_]+"), levels = c("NTC", "KO")),
           group_lab = group |>
             str_replace_all("_", " ") |>
             str_replace("AZA IFNg", "AZA \n+ IFN-y") |>
             str_replace("^NTC", "CTRL"),
           group_lab = factor(group_lab, levels = unique(group_lab[order(match(group, groups))])))
}

# ---- Motif sites in consensus peaks of a region ----
get_locus_motifs <- function(region, peaks, pwm, fa, min_score) {
  pk   <- subsetByOverlaps(peaks, region)
  seqs <- getSeq(fa, pk)
  names(seqs) <- pk$peak_id
  hits <- findMotifHits(query = pwm, subject = seqs, min.score = min_score, method = "matchPWM")
  tibble(peak_id = as.character(seqnames(hits)),
         motif   = as.character(hits$pwmname),
         score   = hits$score,
         mid     = (start(hits) + end(hits)) / 2) |>
    mutate(gpos = start(pk)[match(peak_id, pk$peak_id)] + mid - 1)
}

# ---- Locus figure: coverage / gene model / motif sites ----
plot_locus <- function(cov, gene_tbl, ex_tbl, mot, x_lim, chr, strand, prom = NULL) {
  prom_layer <- if (!is.null(prom))
    geom_vline(data = prom, aes(xintercept = tss), linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey50")
  x_scale  <- scale_x_continuous(labels = \(x) sprintf("%.2f", x / 1e6), expand = c(0, 0))
  gm_rows  <- distinct(gene_tbl, label, y)
  y_top    <- max(gm_rows$y) + 0.9

  p_cov <- ggplot(cov) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = 0, ymax = score, fill = genotype)) +
    prom_layer +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal_geno, guide = "none") +
    facet_grid(group_lab ~ ., switch = "y") +
    x_scale + coord_cartesian(xlim = x_lim) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Signal (TMM)") +
    theme_pub +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.line.x = element_blank(),
          strip.placement = "outside", strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1))

  p_gene <- ggplot() +
    geom_segment(data = filter(gene_tbl, !body), aes(x = start, xend = end, y = y, yend = y),
                 colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_segment(data = filter(gene_tbl, body), aes(x = start, xend = end, y = y, yend = y),
                 colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.6,
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(1.5, "mm"), ends = if (strand == "-") "first" else "last")) +
    geom_rect(data = ex_tbl, aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = y - 0.25, ymax = y + 0.25), fill = "grey20") +
    prom_layer +
    { if (!is.null(prom)) geom_text(data = prom, aes(x = tss, y = y_top, label = promoter, hjust = hjust), size = 3.3) } +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = gm_rows$y, labels = gm_rows$label,
                       limits = c(0.5, y_top + 0.5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    x_scale + coord_cartesian(xlim = x_lim) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_pub +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), axis.line = element_blank())

  p_mot <- ggplot(mot, aes(gpos, motif, size = score, colour = motif)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
    prom_layer +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 4), name = "PWM\nscore") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal_motif, guide = "none") +
    x_scale + coord_cartesian(xlim = x_lim) +
    labs(x = paste0(chr, " (Mb)"), y = NULL) +
    theme_pub

  p_cov / p_gene / p_mot +
    plot_layout(heights = c(3, 0.4 + 0.3 * nrow(gm_rows), 1))
}
```

## Ciita locus

```{r, fig.width = 5, fig.height = 4.2}
# ---- Promoters: TSS clusters of transcripts splicing into the common exon 2 ----
ciita     <- gtf[which(gtf$gene_name == "Ciita")]
ciita_ex  <- ciita[ciita$type == "exon"]
ex2       <- ciita_ex[as.character(ciita_ex$exon_number) == "2"]
ex2_start <- start(resize(ex2, 1, fix = "start"))
tx_main   <- ex2$transcript_id[ex2_start == as.integer(names(which.max(table(ex2_start))))]

tss  <- resize(ciita_ex[as.character(ciita_ex$exon_number) == "1" & ciita_ex$transcript_id %in% tx_main],
               1, fix = "start")
prom <- GenomicRanges::reduce(tss, min.gapwidth = 500, with.revmap = TRUE)
prom <- prom[order(start(prom))]
stopifnot(length(prom) == 3, all(strand(prom) == "+"))

prom_tx  <- map_chr(as.list(prom$revmap), \(i) paste(unique(tss$transcript_name[i]), collapse = ","))

prom_tbl <- tibble(promoter    = c("pI", "pIII", "pIV"),
                   tss         = start(prom),
                   transcripts = prom_tx,
                   hjust       = c(0.5, 1.15, -0.15))

# ---- Gene model: gene body (collapsed exons) + one row per promoter isoform ----
ciita_body <- range(ciita[ciita$type == "transcript"])
tx_prom    <- prom_tbl |>
  select(promoter, transcript_name = transcripts) |>
  separate_rows(transcript_name, sep = ",") |>
  mutate(label = paste0(promoter, " (", transcript_name, ")"))

ciita_rows <- tibble(label = c("Ciita", tx_prom$label)) |> mutate(y = rev(seq_along(label)))

ciita_gene_tbl <- bind_rows(
  tibble(label = "Ciita", start = start(ciita_body), end = end(ciita_body), body = TRUE),
  as_tibble(ciita[ciita$type == "transcript" & ciita$transcript_name %in% tx_prom$transcript_name]) |>
    inner_join(tx_prom, by = "transcript_name") |>
    transmute(label, start, end, body = FALSE)) |>
  left_join(ciita_rows, by = "label")

ciita_ex_tbl <- bind_rows(
  as_tibble(GenomicRanges::reduce(ciita_ex)) |> transmute(label = "Ciita", start, end),
  as_tibble(ciita_ex[ciita_ex$transcript_name %in% tx_prom$transcript_name]) |>
    inner_join(tx_prom, by = "transcript_name") |>
    transmute(label, start, end)) |>
  left_join(ciita_rows, by = "label")

# ---- Region, coverage, motif sites ----
ciita_region <- GRanges(as.character(seqnames(ciita_body)),
                        IRanges(start(ciita_body) - params$ciita_flank, end(ciita_body) + 2000))

ciita_cov <- get_tmm_coverage(ciita_region, edger_obj$y, bam_files, params$groups, params$bin_width)
ciita_mot <- get_locus_motifs(ciita_region, all_peaks, track_pwm, fa, 6)

p_ciita <- plot_locus(ciita_cov, ciita_gene_tbl, ciita_ex_tbl, ciita_mot,
                      x_lim  = c(start(ciita_region), end(ciita_region)),
                      chr    = as.character(seqnames(ciita_region)),
                      strand = as.character(strand(ciita_body)),
                      prom   = prom_tbl)

ggsave(file.path(params$fig_dir, "ciita_locus.pdf"), p_ciita,
        width = 5, height = 4.2)
```

# ---- Gene body only (collapsed exons) ----
cd40      <- gtf[which(gtf$gene_name == "Cd40")]
cd40_body <- range(cd40[cd40$type == "gene"])

cd40_gene_tbl <- tibble(label = "Cd40", y = 1, start = start(cd40_body), end = end(cd40_body), body = TRUE)
cd40_ex_tbl   <- as_tibble(GenomicRanges::reduce(cd40[cd40$type == "exon"])) |>

p_cd40 <- plot_locus(cd40_cov, cd40_gene_tbl, cd40_ex_tbl, cd40_mot,
                     x_lim  = c(start(cd40_region), end(cd40_region)),
                     chr    = as.character(seqnames(cd40_region)),
                     strand = as.character(strand(cd40_body)))

ggsave(file.path(params$fig_dir, "cd40_locus.pdf"), p_cd40,
       width = 5, height = 3.6, device = cairo_pdf)

## Ciita pIV accessibility

```{r, fig.width = 4.5, fig.height = 2.8}
# ---- Per-sample TMM logCPM of the pIV peak ----
lcpm <- cpm(edger_obj$y, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)
trt_lvls <- c("VEH", "AZA", "AZA_IFNg")
trt_labs <- c("VEH", "AZA", "AZA + IFN-γ")

piv_tbl <- tibble(group = as.character(edger_obj$y$samples$group), logCPM = lcpm[params$piv_peak, ]) |>
  mutate(genotype  = factor(str_extract(group, "^[^_]+"), levels = c("NTC", "KO")),
         treatment = factor(str_remove(group, "^[^_]+_"), levels = trt_lvls, labels = trt_labs))

# ---- KO vs NTC FDR per treatment (edgeR QL) ----
fdr_tbl <- imap(edger_obj$res, \(r, ctr) tibble(contrast = ctr, FDR = r$FDR[r$peak_id == params$piv_peak])) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  mutate(treatment = factor(str_remove(contrast, "^KO_vs_NTC_"), levels = trt_lvls, labels = trt_labs),
         label     = paste0("FDR = ", formatC(FDR, format = "g", digits = 2)))

p_piv <- ggplot(piv_tbl, aes(treatment, logCPM, fill = genotype)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.6,
               position = position_dodge(0.75)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = genotype), size = 1.2,
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.12, dodge.width = 0.75)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal_geno) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal_geno, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Accessibility (TMM)", fill = NULL, title = "Ciita pIV promoter peak") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.line        = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
        axis.ticks       = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size  = unit(5, "mm"),
        plot.title       = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold")) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

p_piv

ggsave(file.path(params$fig_dir, "ciita_pIV_accessibility_boxplots.pdf"), p_piv,
       width = 4.5, height = 2.8,  device = cairo_pdf)
```

## Motif enrichment in KO-opened peaks

```{r, fig.width = 5.5, fig.height = 4.5}
# ---- Up-class enrichment per contrast, selected motifs ----
heat_tbl <- imap(cls_se, \(se, ctr)
  tibble(motif_name   = unname(rowData(se)$motif.name),
         log2enr      = assay(se, "log2enr")[, "Up"],
         negLog10Padj = assay(se, "negLog10Padj")[, "Up"],
         contrast     = ctr)) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  filter(motif_name %in% params$heat_motifs) |>
  mutate(motif_name = factor(motif_name, levels = rev(params$heat_motifs)),
         contrast   = factor(str_remove(contrast, "^KO_vs_NTC_"), levels = trt_lvls, labels = trt_labs),
         stars      = case_when(negLog10Padj > 3              ~ "***",
                                negLog10Padj > 2              ~ "**",
                                negLog10Padj > -log10(0.05)   ~ "*",
                                TRUE                          ~ ""))
stopifnot(all(params$heat_motifs %in% heat_tbl$motif_name))

# ---- Logo panel: motif names + sequence logos, rows aligned with the heatmap ----
pfm_all  <- rowData(cls_se[[1]])$motif.pfm
logo_pfm <- pfm_all[match(params$heat_motifs, map_chr(as.list(pfm_all), name))]
n_mot    <- length(params$heat_motifs)
y_pos    <- rev(seq_len(n_mot))
max_w    <- max(map_int(as.list(logo_pfm), \(m) ncol(Matrix(m))))

p_logo <- purrr::reduce(seq_len(n_mot), \(p, i)
  p + annotation_custom(seqLogoGrob(logo_pfm[[i]], xmax = max_w, xjust = "left"),
                        xmin = 0, xmax = 1, ymin = y_pos[i] - 0.42, ymax = y_pos[i] + 0.42),
  .init = ggplot(tibble(x = c(0, 1), y = c(0.5, n_mot + 0.5)), aes(x, y)) +
    geom_blank() +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = y_pos, labels = params$heat_motifs,
                       limits = c(0.5, n_mot + 0.5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_pub +
    theme(axis.line = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank()))

# ---- Heatmap ----
lim <- max(abs(heat_tbl$log2enr))

p_heat <- ggplot(heat_tbl, aes(contrast, motif_name, fill = log2enr)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = stars), size = 4.5, vjust = 0.75) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
                       limits = c(-lim, lim), name = "log2\nenrichment") +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "KO-opened peaks") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(axis.line        = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
        axis.ticks       = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size  = unit(4, "mm"),
        plot.title       = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

p_motif <- p_logo + p_heat + plot_layout(widths = c(1.3, 1))
p_motif

ggsave(file.path(params$fig_dir, "motif_enrichment_up.pdf"), p_motif,
       width = 5.5, height = 4.5, device = cairo_pdf)
```
